plastics.name: Low-Density Polyethylene (LDPE / LLDPE)
plastics.suitable_foods: Fresh bread, frozen vegetables, squeeze bottles, milk pouch sealing layer
plastics.food_contact_notes: Very inert, excellent heat-seal integrity, widely used as the inner sealant layer in multilayer laminates.

plastics.name: High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE)
plastics.suitable_foods: Milk bottles, edible oil containers, dry grain liners, closures and caps
plastics.food_contact_notes: Stiff, moisture-resistant, excellent chemical and stress crack resistance.

plastics.name: Biaxially Oriented Polypropylene (BOPP)
plastics.suitable_foods: Confectionery, biscuits, tea packets, pasta, snack outer wrappers
plastics.food_contact_notes: High clarity, high tensile strength, excellent printability, moisture shield.

plastics.name: Metallized BOPP (Met-BOPP)
plastics.suitable_foods: Potato chips, fried namkeen, roasted nuts, coffee powders
plastics.food_contact_notes: Microscopic vacuum-deposited aluminum layer provides an exceptional barrier against light and oxygen to prevent lipid rancidity.

plastics.name: Polyethylene Terephthalate (PET / APET)
plastics.suitable_foods: Carbonated beverages, fruit juices, honey, edible oils, punnets for berries
plastics.food_contact_notes: Crystal clear, rigid, excellent gas and aroma barrier, recyclable.

plastics.name: Ethylene Vinyl Alcohol (EVOH)
plastics.suitable_foods: Vacuum packed meat, fresh paneer, aseptic fruit purees, oxygen-sensitive sauces
plastics.food_contact_notes: Highest gas barrier polymer available; co-extruded in 5 to 9 layer films shielded by PE layers.

paper_and_board.name: Greaseproof Paper
paper_and_board.suitable_foods: Bakery goods, burgers, fried street food wrapping, samosas, butter wrapping
paper_and_board.food_contact_notes: Produced by mechanical hydration of fibers; safe, non-toxic, certified food-grade alternative to newspaper.

paper_and_board.name: Virgin Bleached Sulfate (SBS) Paperboard
paper_and_board.suitable_foods: Dry cereal cartons, frozen food boxes, tea cartons, takeout meal boxes
paper_and_board.food_contact_notes: Made from 100% virgin pulp, compliant with heavy metal limits (Pb < 3 mg/kg).

glass.name: Type III Soda-Lime Silica Glass
glass.suitable_foods: Pickles, jams, sauces, baby food, alcoholic beverages, clarified butter (ghee)
glass.food_contact_notes: Gold standard for chemical inertness; 100% recyclable; amber glass blocks harmful UV wavelengths.

metals.name: Lacquered Electrolytic Tinplate (ETP)

barrier_properties.barrier: Complete barrier to light, gas, moisture, and microbes

metals.suitable_foods: Canned mango pulp, processed mushrooms, rasgullas, condensed milk, canned fish
metals.food_contact_notes: Requires food-grade interior lacquer (epoxy-phenolic, polyester, or oleoresinous) to avoid metal acid etching.

metals.name: Aluminum Foil Laminate (Alu-Foil)

barrier_properties.barrier: Zero pinhole permeability at thickness >= 9 microns

metals.suitable_foods: Retort meals, milk powder, pharmaceutical nutraceuticals, military rations
metals.food_contact_notes: Provides an impenetrable barrier to light, gas, moisture, and odors.
